blocks.text: Why manual freight broker market data analysis burns you out

The core issue is that you act as a human data relay. You pull rates from DAT, verify capacity on Truckstop, and then manually input those numbers into your TMS. This cycle repeats for every single load. It is not just slow. It is prone to error. When you misprice a load because you missed a recent rate spike, your margins suffer immediately.
The hidden costs of slow research

Every minute spent on manual data entry is a minute you are not building relationships with shippers or carriers. Margin compression is the silent killer here. When your cost of purchased transportation rises faster than the rate you charge the shipper, you lose money. Manual research often misses these fast-moving trends until it is too late.
Fixing your workflow without expensive software

items: Standardize your browser setup. Use Chrome or Safari profiles specifically for logistics work to keep your load boards and TMS separate from personal tabs.
Consolidate your data sources. Instead of checking five different sites, pick two primary sources like DAT iQ or Truckstop and master their API or export features.
Use keyboard shortcuts. Master ⌘ + T for new tabs and ⌘ + 1 to 9 to switch between your active load boards instantly.
Create templates for your outreach. Use a text expander or the built-in Text Replacement in System Settings > Keyboard to quickly drop standard rate inquiry language into Gmail.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps with freight broker market data analysis

Lazur acts as your research assistant on your Mac. You do not need to click through every page to find a specific rate. Hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask about the data on your screen. Lazur will summarize the page or point out the exact metric you need to watch.
Efficiency comes from a consistent routine. Do not try to change everything at once. Start by automating your morning data check.

faq.question: Can I use Lazur on Windows?
faq.answer: No. Lazur is built exclusively for macOS.

faq.question: Does Lazur change my TMS settings?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you, points at things, and answers your questions.

faq.question: Is my carrier data safe?
faq.answer: Yes. Lazur only sees your screen when you hold the shortcut. It does not store your data or use it to train AI models.
